svg.title: Estimating the changed heat loss and revising the integral gain
svg.desc: Heater B is held at 60 points and then 70 points for 30 seconds each. The steady first window gives the right number but is rejected; the second moves the temperature 2.47 degrees Celsius and its estimate of 8.0 kilowatts per degree Celsius is accepted, setting B's integral gain to 0.4. After the 3-degree setpoint step B reaches 63 percent in 9.9 seconds without overshoot, while A with the old gain overshoots to 38.013 degrees Celsius.
svg.text: Estimating the changed heat loss and revising the integral gain
Control Studio recording of this project · heat loss 8 kW/°C · B estimates it in two windows, A keeps the old gains · numbers answer the predictions

A overshoots to 38.013 °C, within 0.2 °C from 18.4 s;
